purpose: AC-3(b) allows a differing position to be accounted for by a DOCUMENTED reordering/precision mechanism. This file is that documentation, in machine-checkable form. It is human-authored and reviewed; the gate never writes to it.
rules: An entry excuses exactly ONE position: prompt_id + position + the explicit list of batch_sizes + the exact ref_top1_id + the exact engine_id must all match. There are no wildcards.
An entry with an empty `mechanism` string excuses nothing (final/ac3_criteria.py:_match_mechanism).
An entry can never lift the >=90% agreement floor: the floor is computed on raw matches and is not waivable.
Every applied entry is printed in the run report and listed in report.json, so a waiver is always visible in the artifact.
`mechanism` must name the mechanism (what in the engine produces this exact difference), and `evidence` must point at the artifact that establishes it.
